AmmoList.use: object name of the ammunition as it will be used by the sheet

ArmourList.use: object name of the armour as it will be used by the sheet

ClassList.use: object name of the class as it will be used by the sheet

CreatureList.use: object name of the creature as it will be used by the sheet

FeatsList.use: object name of the feat as it will be used by the sheet

GearList.use: object name of the piece of equipment as it will be used by the sheet

MagicItemsList.use: object name of the magic item as it will be used by the sheet

RequiredSheetVersion.type: function call with one variable, a string or number
RequiredSheetVersion.use: the minimum and maximum versions of the sheet required for the add-on script to work

SpellsList.use: the SpellsList object name that this attack is linked to

ToolsList.use: object name of the tool as it will be used by the sheet

WeaponsList.use: object name of the weapon as it will be used by the sheet

ability.type: number corresponding to the ability score (1 = Str, 2 = Dex, 3 = Con, 4 = Int, 5 = Wis, 6 = Cha)
ability.use: set the ability score used for weapon/attack

abilitytodamage.use: whether (true) or not (false) to add the ability score modifier to the damage

ac.use: the base AC the armour gives without modifiers from Dexterity or other ability scores

action.use: add entry to the "Actions", "Bonus Actions", or "Reactions" section on the 1st page

actions.use: add text to the Traits and Features sections on the Companion page

addMod.use: set to 'true' if the armour can have a secondary ability score modifier added to the AC

addTo.use: to what the bonus spells should be added

addToExisting.use: entries to add to the "Limited Features" section which are not level-dependent

additional.use: value to add in brackets to the name in the "Limited Features" section

adv_vs.use: add strings to the "Adv. on saves vs." text on the 1st page

advantages.use: set advantage on an ability check, saving throw, or attacks

affectsDuplicates.use: change aspects of spells when generating a spell sheet of the parent object

affectsWildShape.use: whether (true) or not (false) this armour can be used while in a Wild Shape

allModes.use: add a modifier to all movement modes, if present, except those excluded

allowDuplicates.use: set to true if multiples can exist of this feat (e.g. Elemental Adept using the 'choices' attribute)

allowUpCasting.use: do not limit spells to only be cast at their lowest level

altResource.use: value to add in the "Recovery" column in the "Limited Features" section in addition to the 'recovery' attribute

alternatives.use: used to match the text in the ammunition field to see if this ammo is present

amendTo.use: if this string is found on any Notes page, than this note is added to the found note section

ammo.use: the AmmoList object name of the ammunition that this attack uses

ammoAdd.type: array (variable length) of arrays with 2 entries
ammoAdd.use: adds each entry in the array to one of the ammunition drop-downs on the 1st page

ammoAmount.use: set the amount of ammunition to add to the first page (if `type` = "ammo")

ammoOptions.use: adds each object in the array to the AmmoList variable

amount.use: number of the gear as it will be added in the equipment fields, "#" column

armorAdd.use: select armor as current and/or edit the available options in the drop-down

armorOptions.use: adds each object in the array to the ArmourList variable

atkAdd.use: dynamically change what is put in the fields of an attack entry

atkCalc.use: dynamically change how the To Hit and Damage of attacks are calculated

attackOnly.use: include/exclude spells based on if they use a spell attack

attacksAction.use: set the number of attacks per action

attributesAdd.type: object containing any attributes of the CreatureList object
attributesAdd.use: add or overwrite attributes in the base CreatureList object

attributesChange.use: change attributes of the temporary CreatureList object

attunement.use: set to true if the magic item requires attunement

baseWeapon.use: the WeaponsList object name that this attack is based on

bonus.use: positive number (minimum of 1) with the amount of extrachoices to add

bonusClassExtrachoices.type: array of objects (variable length) or just a single object
bonusClassExtrachoices.use: increase allowed number of extrachoices for another class feature

calcChanges.use: change how the hit points automation works

calculate.use: this string is set as the field calculation method for the description field of the feat

carryingCapacity.use: multiply the carrying capacity (encumbrance) with this number

changeeval.use: runs a piece of code every time the main character's level changes

changes.use: change aspects of spells when generating a spell sheet of the parent object

choicesNotInMenu.use: omit the choices from the item menu (i.e. only list the main item's name)

chooseGear.use: ask the player what type of gear (weapon, armor, ammunition) the item should be

class.use: the ClassList object name of the class the feature belong to

companion.type: array of strings (or string, for backwards compatibility)
companion.use: list this creature as an option for a special type of companion

companionApply.use: always set this creature to be this special type of companion

companionCallback.use: dynamically change the companion page after something has been turned into a special type of companion (e.g. Find Familiar or Ranger's Companion)

condition_immunities.use: add text to the Features section on the Companion/Wild Shape page

creatureCallback.use: dynamically change the companion page after a creature was selected on it

creatureOptions.use: adds each object in the array to the CreatureList variable

damage.use: determine the damage die and type of the damage

damage_immunities.use: add text to the Features section on the Companion/Wild Shape page

damage_resistances.use: add text to the Features section on the Companion/Wild Shape page

damage_vulnerabilities.use: add text to the Features section on the Companion/Wild Shape page

dc.use: whether (true) or not (false) this weapon uses a DC instead of a To Hit

defaultExcluded.use: whether this feat should be excluded by default (true) or included by default (false)

description.use: the text to be filled in the description field of the feat

descriptionChange.use: what part of the magic item's description to add the name of the selected gear to

descriptionFull.use: description of the feat as it appears in its source

descriptionLong.use: the text to be filled in the description field of the magic item, but only on the overflow page

dex.use: the maximum Dexterity modifier that can be added to the AC with this armour

die.use: number of the type of hit die the class has (i.e. 10 means d10)

dmgres.use: add entry to the "Resistances" section on the 1st page

eval.type: variable, see the entries for `eval`, `removeeval`, or `addMod`
eval.use: variable, see the entries for `eval`, `removeeval`, or `addMod`

excludeCheck.use: filter things from the list of weapon, armor, or ammunition from the options

extraAC.type: array of objects (variable length) or just a single object
extraAC.use: add modifier and description to AC magic/misc fields

extraLimitedFeatures.use: entries to add to the "Limited Features" section which are not level-dependent

extraTooltip.use: text to add to the bullet points in the tooltip for the magic item

extraspells.type: array (variable length) of spell object names as used in the SpellsList object
extraspells.use: add spells to final list regardless if they meet the other requirements

featsAdd.type: array (variable length) of strings or objects
featsAdd.use: adds each entry in the array to one of the feat drop-downs

feature.use: the object name listed in the `features` attribute of the ClaasList or ClassSubList object

features.use: add text to the Traits and Features sections on the Companion page

fixedDC.use: set the DC and spell attack to a fixed value, not dependent on ability score

fixedSpAttack.use: set the spell attack and DC to a fixed value, not dependent on ability score

forceStealthDis.use: armours matching this always impose disadvantage on stealth checks

forceWildshapeOption.use: force the entry to appear as a wild shape option

hdLinked.type: array with ClassList object names (variable length) or function
hdLinked.use: dynamically set the number of HD to a class level (array) or anything you want (function)

header.use: set the single-word header at the top left of the companion page

hp.use: set the maximum amount of hit points

hpForceRecalc.use: recalculate the Max HP tooltip (and value, if set to automatic) whenever anything changes

iFileName.use: how the file will be named in the sheet if you import it as a file

icon.use: icon to use for the ammunition

immune.use: add strings to the "Immune to" text on the 1st page

includeCheck.use: filter things from the list of creatures to create the menu options

infoname.use: name of the gear as it will be displayed in the equipment menu

invName.use: the name used when adding the armour from the Armor/Defense section to the Equipment section

isAlwaysProf.use: whether (true) or not (false) the proficiency bonus should always be added for this weapon

isMagicAmmo.use: whether (true) or not (false) this ammunition is magical ammunition

isMagicArmor.use: whether (true) or not (false) this armour is a magical armour

isMagicWeapon.use: whether (true) or not (false) this weapon is a magical weapon

isNotWeapon.use: whether (false) or not (true) this attack is counted as a weapon

itemName1stPage.use: how the name added to the 1st page should look like

languages.use: add text to the Features section on the Companion/Wild Shape page

level.type: array with two number entries: lower and upper limit of level of spells
level.use: spells not within this level range will be excluded from the final list

limfeaAddToExisting.use: set to `true` to have the number set for `usages` be added to an existing limited feature by the same name, instead of overwriting it

limfeaname.use: value to add in the "Name" column in the "Limited Features" section instead of the feature's name

list.use: determines the sorting of the armour in the drop-down field

magic.use: set this to true if this should be added to the Magic line in the AC/Defense section

magicItemComponents.use: change all spell components on the spell sheet to "Mƒ" (only a magic item)

magicItemTable.type: string or array of strings (variable length)
magicItemTable.use: define what table(s) in the DMG that the magic item appears on (or as listed in the AL Content Catalog)

magicitemsAdd.type: array (variable length) of strings or arrays (with a string and a boolean)
magicitemsAdd.use: adds each entry in the array to one of the magic item drop-downs

minlevel.use: the level at which to add the feature, trait, or action

minlevelLinked.type: array with ClassList object names (variable length) or function
minlevelLinked.use: dynamically select which level to use for level-dependent features

mod.use: the modifier to add to the AC

modifiers.use: add something to the weapon's modifier fields

monkweapon.use: whether (true) or not (false) this weapon is a monk weapon and should use the Martial Arts die

name.use: name of the feat as it will be used by the sheet

nameAlt.use: alternative setting-independent name with which the sheet can recognize the magic item

nameMenu.use: name of the companion option as it will appear in the Companion Options menu

nameTest.use: alternative name with which the sheet can recognize the magic item

nameTooltip.use: name of the companion options as it will appear in tooltips for actions on the 1st page

noStealthDis.use: armours matching this never impose disadvantage on stealth checks

notLegalAL.use: set this to true if it the item is not legal in Adventurers League play

note.use: the text of the feature to add to the notes section

notes.use: add text to the Traits and Features sections on the Companion page

notspells.type: array (variable length) of spell object names as used in the SpellsList object
notspells.use: spells to remove from the final list

origin.use: the string to use instead of the name (and minlevel) of the parent object

page3notes.use: whether to add this to the 3rd page's Notes section (true) or on a Notes page (false)

popupName.use: the text used in the informational "changes" pop-up dialog to show the player what and on what page the text was added

prefixOrSuffix.use: determine how the name of the selected gear is added to the name of the magic item

prereqeval.type: function or, for backwards-compatibility, string that is evaluated using eval()
prereqeval.use: this should return 'true' if the prerequisite is met or 'false' otherwise

prereqs.use: prerequisite abilities to multiclass in the class, to be displayed in the Ability Scores dialog when multiclassing

prerequisite.use: textual explanation of a prerequisite the feat has

primaryAbility.use: abilities that are essential to the class to be displayed in the Ability Scores dialog

proficiencyBonusLinked.use: whether the proficiency bonus is the same (true) as the main character or not (false)

psionic.use: include/exclude spells based on if they are psionic or not

range.use: the text as it will be put in the Range field for the attack

rarity.use: define what rarity the magic item is, to be used in the tooltip and to sort the item

recovery.use: value to add in the "Recovery" column in the "Limited Features" section

regExpSearch.use: used to match the text in the class field to see if this class is present

removeeval.use: runs a piece of code when the creature is removed from the Companion page

ritual.use: include/exclude spells based on if they are ritual spells or not

savesLinked.use: whether the total save bonus is the same (true) as the main character or not (false)

savetxt.use: add text to the 1st page "Saving Throws" section

school.type: array (variable length) of spell school names as used in the spellSchoolList object
school.use: spells not in one of the schools listed will be excluded from the final list

selectNow.use: whether (true) or not (false) this weapon should immediately be selected

selection.use: select which of the spells from the drop-down to select

selfChoosing.use: select the 'choice' automatically when the feat is added

senses.use: add text to the Senses section on the Companion page

setAltHp.use: set the maximum HP field to automatically assume the alternative calculation method added with the `hp` function

shieldAdd.type: string or array with three entries
shieldAdd.use: set the shield on the 1st page as well as its bonus to AC and weight

size.use: set the size category drop-down box

skills.type: object with skill names as attribute names
skills.use: set the proficiency, expertise, and extra bonus for skills

skillstxt.use: description of skill proficiencies and skill proficiency choices gained, to use in the tooltips of skills

source.type: array with two entries (or array of these arrays)
source.use: define where the feat is found

special.use: whether (true) or not (false) this weapon has the 'special' property

spellAdd.use: dynamically change aspects of spells when it is added on the spell sheet

spellCalc.use: dynamically change how spell attacks, spell save DC, and/or number of spells prepared are calculated

spellChanges.use: change aspects of spells when generating a spell sheet of the parent object

spellFirstColTitle.use: set the title of the first column of the header on the spell sheet page(s)

spellList.use: dynamically change what is included and excluded from the spell list of a class (or other spellcasting source)

spellcastingAbility.type: number corresponding to the ability score (1 = Str, 2 = Dex, 3 = Con, 4 = Int, 5 = Wis, 6 = Cha)
spellcastingAbility.use: set the ability score used for spellcasting abilities

spellcastingBonus.type: array of objects (or just a single object)
spellcastingBonus.use: adds entries to the "Bonus Spells" section of the spell selection dialog

spellcastingBonusElsewhere.use: add spells to a spellcasting feature other than the parent object

spellcastingExtra.use: adds the spells in the array to the list of spells to choose from

spellcastingExtraApplyNonconform.use: whether to use the default (false) or variant (true) way of adding the spells defined by `spellcastingExtra` (see above)

spellcastingPreparedCantrips.use: show all cantrips on the spell sheet, with checkboxes in the first column

spells.type: array (variable length) of spell object names as used in the SpellsList object
spells.use: spells to use for the final list

stealthdis.use: set to 'true' if the armour gives disadvantage on stealth checks

stopeval.use: return 'true' if the modifier is NOT to be added

storyItemAL.use: set this to true if it is a 'Story Item' in Adventurers League play

strReq.use: the minimum required Strength score to wear this armour without being encumbered

subclass.use: the ClassSubList object name of the subclass the feature belong to

subtype.use: add the subtype in the type drop-down box

text.use: add a text to the 1st page

toNotesPage.type: array of objects (or just a single object)
toNotesPage.use: adds entries to the Notes section on either the 3rd page or a separate Notes page

tooltip.use: this will be added as a tooltip to the Description field for the attack

traits.use: add text to the Traits and Features sections on the Companion page

type.use: define which type of feat this is

usages.type: number, string, or array with 20 entries
usages.use: value to add in the "Usages" column in the "Limited Features" section

usagescalc.use: this string is set as the field calculation method for the "Usages" field in the "Limited Features" section

useDescriptionFull.use: whether to use the parent feature's `descriptionFull` as the note

useSpellMod.use: the object name of a spellcasting object that this attack will use the spell attack/DC from

useSpellcastingAbility.use: force the use of the spellcasting ability for the weapon

vision.use: add string to the "Senses" field on the 1st page

walk.use: add movement mode of the object's name

weaponOptions.use: adds each object in the array to the WeaponsList variable

weaponProfs.type: array with two or three entries

weaponsAdd.use: add attack(s) to and/or edit the available options in 1st page attack section

weight.use: the weight of the magic item in lb

wildshapeCallback.use: dynamically change a wild shape whenever it is calculated

wildshapeShow.use: change or stop text on the wild shape page

wildshapeString.use: add text to the Traits & Features section on the Wild Shape page
